title: Tech Note: A Look at The Features of 4D View Pro
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D View Pro (built on SpreadJS, 64-bit, object-based) is still 4D's current spreadsheet/grid technology and has continued to receive substantial feature updates since this v17R4-era note; the legacy 32-bit 4D View plugin it describes as being deprecated has since been fully retired from current 4D releases.
related_updates: legacy 4D View plugin (32-bit) is no longer usable/available in current 4D versions

4D View Pro has evolved considerably since v17R4 with many new APIs, and its underlying SpreadJS engine has been upgraded multiple times, so specific API/behavior details from this note should be checked against current documentation
list box features like Object Type Arrays and Row/Automatic Row Height remain valid concepts still in use today
